applies_to: PVI DigiTemp Jr. digital 3-way hot water mixing valves (control module 1096).
summary: DigiTemp Jr. is a digital 3-way mixing valve for domestic hot water. Its control module talks BACnet MS/TP (or Modbus RTU) on terminals 6-8. The object list is nine read-only analog inputs (outlet temperature, valve signal, recorded highs/lows, alert settings and counts, error code) and one setpoint the BMS can write.
firmware: Application software J1279, firmware 1.0.2 (per the PICS)
notes: The object table has no read/write column; AV 0 is marked writable here because the manual says the BAS can adjust the setpoint remotely, and the AIs are read-only by object type.
The PICS lists Binary Output as a supported object type, but the manual prints no BO objects.
The "Others / ERROR" rows in the manual mean unlisted instances return an error; they are not real objects.
The PICS says BACnet IP is not supported.

integration.summary: Set BAS Type to BACnet MS/TP in the Building Automation menu, then set the device ID, MS/TP address and baud rate. Wire RS-485 to terminals 6 (-), 7 (+) and 8 (GND). Write AV 0 for the outlet setpoint and read the temperature, valve signal and error code.
setup: BAS Type defaults to NONE; choose BACnet MS/TP in Setup > BAS.
Set BACnet Device ID, BAC-MSTP Address and BACnet baud rate on the same menu.
RS-485 wiring: terminals 6 (-), 7 (+), 8 (GND) on control module 1096.
gotchas: MS/TP only; there is no BACnet IP option.
No segmentation support per the PICS.

source.title: DigiTemp Jr. Digital Water Mixing Valve User Guide & Instruction Manual (BAS Integration section)
